interpretation: The control deliberately permits ApplyPatch after WriteCap(DOM) revocation. The positive profile rejects this transition and leaves the prepared patch pending. This is a safety witness only; the lifecycle policy for the pending patch (discard, retry/recompute, or bounded lease) remains an owner decision and is not selected by this model.
scope: Finite two-event candidate interleaving; not a normative decision on pending-patch disposal, deadline, or frame behaviour.
